chunks: The day all mankind will stand before the Lord of all the worlds
ai.seo_question: What happens to all mankind on the Day of Resurrection according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah as the Lord of all realms, highlighting that the Day of Resurrection is a universal gathering where every individual, regardless of status, stands in humble submission. It serves as a profound reminder of divine justice, reinforcing the belief that all deeds will be accounted for before the ultimate Judge.
